## Download

Download **ferrisping.exe** below and run it. There's no installer, and it needs no admin rights. Your hosts and settings are kept in `%APPDATA%\FerrisPing`.

The exe isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about it the first time: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

SHA-256 of `ferrisping.exe`: `{sha256}`
